scenes.line1: Is your app truly production ready?
scenes.say: You built the app. But can someone else support it when things go wrong? Let's see what real operational readiness means.

scenes.label: Monitoring
scenes.sub: Host, application, and synthetic checks. Dashboards shared.
scenes.say: First, monitoring must cover the host, the app, and synthetic user flows. Share dashboards with your support team.

rows.b: Shipped to central store, retention set
Written and tested for tier one

scenes.say: Next, make sure alerts reach the on-call team and each alert has a runbook. Centralize logs, set retention. Backups are only real if you test restoring them. And for critical apps, test your disaster recovery plan.

scenes.question: Which backup step do teams skip?
scenes.right: Testing a backup restore—always prove you can recover.
scenes.say: Here's a common trap: teams set up backups but skip testing restores. Always prove you can recover your data.
